title: Dominic and the Drop
author: Casper Vane
blurb: Lior Dunmore, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
